The lower zone (F1) carries its own vertical dimension chain, top-down: 400 (gap from the F1/F2 dividing line down to window head), 1000 (window height), 1600 (gap from window sill down to the F1 floor line). World origin_m=3.0 is the F1/F2 dividing line (absolute z=3.0, matching F1 ceiling_height=3.0 from z_floor=0), direction=-1 walks downward. Segment 1 (index 1, the 1000mm window band) yields absolute z=[1.6,2.6], matching the head/sill I already declared for every F1 exterior window.
